metadata.twins:contract:
== TWINS-MASTER — multi-device + multi-session runtime view ==
Read this BEFORE running anything that touches state.
THE TWINS GLOBAL ~/.cc/cc.db user-wide; 28 tables; shared across all projects + devices owned by one user LOCAL <proj>/.cc/local.db per-project; chain runs + scope-specific records; isolated per checkout
DISCOVERY ORDER (cc reads these in order) 1. $CC_LOCAL_DB ← explicit env override 2. $CC_SCOPE_LOCAL_DB ← cc's own scope-walking export 3. walk-up from cwd → .cc/local.db 4. None → "(unscoped)" — only global is touched
SESSION ISOLATION Every cc invocation gets a kernel-uuid → CC_AGENT_UUID. Every write to runs/agents/chats/chain_runs/phase_steps tags the row with this UUID. 5-10 concurrent terminals cannot blur because: - sqlite WAL + busy_timeout=30000ms - PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON - UUIDs disambiguate writers - current_task is a singleton row protected by upsert
MULTI-DEVICE Owner (Tom's laptop) : full read/write to global + every local.db Droplet : runs the studio + proxy; can be read-only if Tom prefers (CC_AUTO_SCOPE=0) Friend laptop : SSH-tunneled into droplet's wardrobe (8510) + IP-bound + salted token Friend tablet/phone : Lucid embed (read-only OAuth scope)
TODOS vs WORKFLOW_JOBS todos quick text tasks scoped to active project (global cc.db) workflow_jobs template instantiation: multi-step with HITL gates (local .cc/local.db OR global cc.db depending on cmd)
AGENTS vs AGENT_DEFS agent_defs reusable prompt templates (cc agent define ...) agents runtime claim slot — one row per CC_AGENT_UUID currently in flight. Auto-released on EXIT trap.
WHEN TO REGENERATE THIS DOC After: schema change in core/lib/db.py, new cmd_X in core/cc, new subsystem in tesseract/projects.py, new device class added to the share story.
